title: Live-Action Blue Lock Film Previews Entrance Exam in New Video
content: The official YouTube channel for the live-action film based on Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's BLUE LOCK soccer manga streamed footage of the entrance exam in a new video on Wednesday. The video features the insert song "twilight" by Fukase .
author: ANN

title: Netflix Streams New Live-Action GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka Series
content: Netflix is streaming the new live-action series based on Tohru Fujisawa 's GTO : Great Teacher Onizuka manga in Japanese with English subtitles in North America. The first episode is now streaming, with new episodes released on Mondays.
author: ANN

title: Heisei Haizan-hei ☆ Sumire-chan Manga Goes on Hiatus Due to Author's Maternity Leave
content: This year's 34th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Tuesday that Satomi U will take a maternity leave between mid-July to mid-October. Her Heisei Haizan-hei ☆ Sumire-chan manga will take a break during that time.
author: ANN

title: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Quietly Goes on Hiatus Ahead of Its Three-Year Anniversary
content: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex returned this month with Chapter 36, and while the installment featured major developments, it also quietly announced an immediate hiatus. The Boruto sequel has consistently released new chapters every month since its debut in August 2023, reaching a total of 36 chapters.
author: ComicBook

title: King of the Hill Says Goodbye to John Redcorn With Major Season 15 Change
content: King of the Hill is back in action with a new season of the revival now streaming with Hulu, and the latest season of the series has said goodbye to John Redcorn with a major change to his relationship with Nancy moving forward.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Super Artist Creates an Official G Gundam Crossover
content: Throughout the history of the Gundam series, there have been certain mech stories that have resonated with anime fans worldwide. Series like the original Mobile Suit Gundam, Gundam Wing, Gundam SEED , and more have become major mech players.

title: Judge Issues 14-Day Restraining Order on Paramount, Warner Bros. Merger
content: The District Court for the Northern District of California issued a 14-day temporary restraining order on Paramount's hostile takeover bid for Warner Bros. Discovery on Monday, prior to Paramount's earliest set date of Tuesday, July 22 for closing the transaction.
author: ANN
